about.title: Locally owned, and named for how we work
text: Just-N-Time AC and Heating is a locally owned and operated HVAC company serving Houston, TX and the surrounding areas. As the name suggests, we pride ourselves on prompt, efficient service, and with years of experience in the industry we have built a reputation for getting every repair or installation right the first time.

Our licensed and experienced technicians cover AC and heater maintenance, AC and heater installation, commercial HVAC preventative maintenance and inspection, air conditioner repair, heater repair, insulation installation, air duct design and smart thermostats. We believe prevention is better than cure, which is why we offer maintenance plans that catch potential issues before they become a problem.

In the event of unexpected damage, our emergency repair services are available around the clock. We also provide free quotes on all projects, so you know what to expect upfront, and we work with superior products that carry excellent warranties under our hassle-free warranty policy.

We support our troops and the community. As part of that we offer financing and leasing options alongside special discounts for seniors and military personnel, and our technicians go through extensive customer service training so that every job ends with a satisfied customer.

faqs.q: How do I know if I need furnace replacement rather than another repair?
faqs.a: If your furnace requires frequent repairs, produces uneven heating, or causes higher energy bills, furnace replacement services may provide a more reliable solution than continued repairs.

faqs.q: How long does a furnace replacement take?
faqs.a: Most furnace replacement projects are completed within one day. The timeline depends on system size, existing setup, and any required airflow adjustments.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of a furnace upgrade?
faqs.a: Furnace upgrade services provide more consistent heating, quieter operation, improved efficiency, and fewer unexpected breakdowns during colder months.

faqs.q: What are the signs that my heater needs a technician?
faqs.a: Six things are worth a call: uneven heating between rooms, banging, rattling or squealing noises, a sudden spike in utility costs, a heater that constantly turns on and off, inconsistent heating in a commercial space, and a unit nearing the end of its lifespan. Recognizing these early prevents bigger problems.

faqs.q: Why does regular HVAC maintenance matter?
faqs.a: Routine maintenance keeps the system running efficiently, which reduces energy waste and lowers monthly bills, and it lets a technician spot minor issues before they turn into costly repairs. It also extends the life of the equipment, because keeping components clean, lubricated and calibrated reduces strain and prevents premature wear.
Yes. Our emergency repair services are available around the clock, outside our posted hours and at weekends.

faqs.q: What warranty do you offer on an installation?
faqs.a: A 10-year parts and labor warranty is available. We work with superior products that offer excellent warranties, in adherence to our hassle-free warranty policy.
Yes. We offer special discounts for seniors and military personnel across our services, as well as financing and leasing options on larger projects.

faqs.q: Why does the size of a new system matter so much?
faqs.a: Correct sizing and placement are what make a system run at peak efficiency. The wrong size leads to short cycling, uneven airflow and unnecessary strain on the equipment, which wastes energy and shortens the life of the unit.

faqs.q: Could my high energy bill be the insulation rather than the AC?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Without proper insulation, your HVAC system has to work overtime to hold the temperature you set, which raises energy costs and leaves rooms uneven. Attic, wall and spray foam insulation seal the gaps so the system does not have to compensate.

faqs.q: What does a programmable thermostat actually save?
faqs.a: It adjusts temperatures automatically through the day and night, so the system is not running when nobody needs it, which shows up on the monthly bill. It also avoids large temperature swings, which reduces strain on the equipment and extends its lifespan.
